## LOAD PACKAGES

library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

```

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

# GET DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS

\## UNADJUSTED

```{r}

combined_plot1 <- perform_diagnostics(unadj_m3AA_summaries_df[[1]]$model, names(unadj_m3AA_summaries_df)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plot2 <- perform_diagnostics(unadj_m3GM_summaries_df[[1]]$model, names(unadj_m3GM_summaries_df)[1]) #global methylation

```

\## HEALTH ONLY

```{r}

combined_plotm1 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAA_summaries_dfm1[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAA_summaries_dfm1)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plotm1GM <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthGM_summaries_dfm1[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthGM_summaries_dfm1)[1]) #global methylation

```

\## HEALTH AND ADULT EXPOSURE

```{r}

  ## Grew up in a rural area
combined_plot5 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultAArural_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultAArural_summaries_dfm2)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plot6 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultGMrural_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultGMrural_summaries_dfm2)[1]) #global methylation
  ## Years in school
combined_plot7 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultAAschlyrs_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultAAschlyrs_summaries_dfm2)[1])
combined_plot8 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultGMschlyrs_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultGMschlyrs_summaries_dfm2)[1])
  ## Live with a grandparent
combined_plot9 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultAAlivegpar_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultAAlivegpar_summaries_dfm2)[1])
combined_plot10 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultGMlivegpar_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultGMlivegpar_summaries_dfm2)[1])
  ## Smoking during childhood
combined_plot11 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultAAchsmk_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultAAchsmk_summaries_dfm2)[1])
combined_plot12 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_HealthAdultGMchsmk_summaries_dfm2[[1]]$model, names(adj_HealthAdultGMchsmk_summaries_dfm2)[1])

```
